{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute overall mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().round(2)

# Print the result to ensure it's captured in evidence
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
